banner.title: The Dragon issue-26 box closing round - the fifth four-round walk complete, issues 2 through 26 all closed
banner.provenance: The pure flip, no new ink - all three report-026 boxes check at this single round: the part-one opener set (R962, t26), the part-two table round (R963, s26) and the part-three commentary set (R964, k26). The walk holds issues 2-26 all closed, the four-round shape five times proven at issues 22, 23, 24, 25 and 26; the TD 27 intake stands unadjudicated with the Sullin and brawling watches - absent a sixth issue - riding on to TD 27. Pinned from The Dragon Vol. III No. 12 (June 1979) number 26, the single-voice transcript of the Curtiss-provided scan at extract/dragon/026, landed in the repo at R962.
